name: ihub-studio
description: iHub Studio — Student-led creative technology, digital media, and campus innovation organization.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@ihub/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@ihub/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@ihub/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ihub/shared && npm run build --workspace=@ihub/backend && npm run build --workspace=@ihub/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@ihub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ihub/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ihub/frontend
